# Focus Highlight Color contract fixture

Control names, values, activators and default colors transcribed from
[FlanGrande v1.2 theme manifest](https://github.com/FlanGrande/SteamDeckFlanTheme/blob/main/FocusHighlightColor/theme.json),
inspected 2026-09-18. The fixture represents the loaded CSS Loader backend shape,
not a downloaded theme or a replacement for Theme Store delivery. It covers the
real Highlight Colors components and the Round Compatibility Yes/No setting.

Percentages spelling was verified from
[the component manifest](https://github.com/elfenermarcell/Steam-Deck-Percentages/blob/main/theme.json).
